plugins.name: vibe-cook-audit
plugins.description: Use when a vibe-coded or hand-written codebase needs a production-readiness audit, security review, feature-completeness check, client-friendly summary, or an hours estimate. Commands: /taste (quick scan), /cook (full audit), /plate (client brief), /bill (estimate). Detects the stack (Stripe, Supabase, Convex, Firebase, Neon, MongoDB, Clerk, Expo, Capacitor, Twilio, AWS, and more) and recommends the official plugin for each.
